# Synthetic negative experiment

## Outcome
Demonstrate that the record checker accepts a complete experiment whose hypothesis was rejected.

## Scope
Included: temporary version-1 records, controlled fixture mutations, and assertions on checker findings.

Excluded: product conclusions or evidence about the real project.

## Acceptance criteria
The structured criterion above is authoritative.

## Execution checkpoint
Synthetic test fixture; the test runner builds a temporary Git repository and reports all cases.

None.

## Evidence
Fixture runner output only; no product evidence.
